approved: The Appropriation Bill (No. 2) 2016-2017 seeks just under $9 billion for non‑ordinary annual services, including $4.9 billion for the National Broadband Network, $1.4 billion for defence (with an additional $700 million for the 2016 defence white paper), $544 million for infrastructure programs such as Roads to Recovery and Western Sydney airport, and $310 million for agriculture, including a $50 million national water infrastructure loan facility.
